OEP1_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT.path: docs/ops/release/FIBDB053_D1_AUDITOR_OEP1_EVIDENCE_v<semver>.json (discovery only: the file name carries no authority; the chain is bound by record ids and digests)
required_fields: verdict (CLOSED only when every gating sub-verdict is PASS)
candidate {commit, package_closure_digest} (the candidate the channel certification event certifies)
derivation_context (the facts the verdict was derived from: binding, targetHost, n08, driverDigest, transport, doBlockGuarded)
predecessor (null for the root, else {record_id, content_digest})
acknowledges [{record_id, content_digest, resolution}] (exactly the earlier links that do not recompute to CLOSED)
content_digest (sha256 of the canonical JSON of the record without this field)
OEP1_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT.recomputation: PMR-14 RECOMPUTES every sub-verdict and the derived classification from the observation and the repository (never trusts the record); a consistent non-PASS record does not close OEP-1 (recertification survivor E1).
invalidation_predicates: IP-1: any CHANNEL_BINDING pin differs from the evidence's hashes.
IP-2: N04's host, the route-B port or database differ from the evidence's.
IP-3: the mint's operator URL names another principal (launcher OC-4 and mint OT-14 refuse).
IP-4: observed_at_utc is not before the effective N08.
IP-5: a later OEP-1 evidence record exists on the chain (it becomes the head and must itself close OEP-1 and acknowledge every earlier non-CLOSED record).
IP-6: the channel certification event is not a terminal PASS for an ancestor carrying the same effective CHANNEL_BINDING.
IP-7: the driver digest differs from the repository's.
IP-8: the pinned trust root (CHANNEL_BINDING.tls) differs from the anchor the evidence observed.

chain.rule: ONE digest-bound chain: unique record_ids; each record's content_digest matches its canonical content; exactly one root; every other record names its predecessor by record_id AND content_digest and that record exists with that digest; no fork, cycle or orphan; each record observed STRICTLY after its predecessor (exact UTC); every link's verdict RECOMPUTED from its own observation and derivation_context (a recorded verdict its facts do not recompute to is refused); the head acknowledges, by id and digest with a resolution, exactly the earlier links that do not recompute to CLOSED, each observed before the head; the head binds the certified candidate and derived its verdict from the context the repository states now; no evidence file was ever deleted, modified or renamed in the history of HEAD.
chain.replaces: the R3 rule (predecessor paths with lower versions; acknowledged_non_closed by path), which accepted a head observed before the FAIL it acknowledged and did not verify predecessors or history (final recertification of b4ca05ac, N-1..N-3).
chain.residual: A merge that adds the same evidence path on two sides is not a deletion in `git log --diff-filter=DMRT`; the certifier reads the history of a PHASE 2 candidate.

PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.why: The final recertification of b4ca05ac measured NODE_OPTIONS=--require=<preload> in the owner console capturing the operator credential before the launcher could reject it. A Node process cannot be its own first boundary.
PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.script: db/custody/pre-node-boundary.ts PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY_PS1 (fixed text, no interpolation), written by the gate as <channel-dir>\d1-pre-node-boundary.ps1
PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.runs_in: the operator shell: Windows PowerShell (powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File); pwsh elsewhere
before_node_exists: refuses (exit 64, naming the variables) when any environment variable matches ^(NODE_.*|OPENSSL_.*|SSL_CERT_FILE|SSL_CERT_DIR|LD_PRELOAD|LD_LIBRARY_PATH|LD_AUDIT|DYLD_.*|UELLIX_D1_MINT_OPERATOR_DATABASE_URL|UELLIX_D1_PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY)$ case-insensitively: NODE_OPTIONS (--require, -r, --import, --loader), NODE_PATH, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED, NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA and every NODE_*, OPENSSL_*, SSL_CERT_FILE/DIR, LD_*/DYLD_* preload variables, and an ambient operator value or boundary mark
refuses unless the node binary named by the plan hashes to its pin
refuses unless the launcher build lies next to the script
PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.starts_node_with: no runtime flags; an environment built from ["SystemRoot","SYSTEMROOT","windir","PATH","Path","TEMP","TMP"] only, plus UELLIX_D1_PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY = the script's own sha256; nothing inherited by omission
PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.launcher_side: OC-15 in the launcher (defence in depth, NOT the boundary): no prompt without the mark for the pinned script, with runtime flags, or with any NODE_* variable.
PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.measured_by: tests/custody/d1-pre-node-boundary.test.ts (real shell, real preload: --require, -r, --import refused with 0 preload executions and nothing captured; each runtime/trust input refused alone; node pin; the clean path runs the channel; control: a direct start lets the preload run and capture)
PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.cannot_defend: the shell that runs it (a hostile profile is excluded with -NoProfile; LD_PRELOAD on the shell precedes the script) and an administrator-level hook (IFEO).
PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.measured_on_this_host: NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA was present in the environment the executor ran in; the boundary refused it. An operator console carrying any NODE_* variable must clear it before the channel starts.
